# OffsetFetchNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.OffsetFetchNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Applies OFFSET/FETCH paging to a child node&#x27;s output. Skips the first P:PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.OffsetFetchNode.Offset rows and then yields at most P:PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.OffsetFetchNode.Fetch rows.
